notes: P-MENU2-e: words for the Fighting Style screen. Plain words, no numbers (D6). Locked items invite, never lock (D3).
hint: Tap a card, then tap a pick.
alwaysEmpty: Strikes and Seals you earn show up here.
noVirtueLine: Your first Virtue comes from a stripe at the dojo.
switchLine: You can still switch Stance during a fight.
virtueLine: Comes out when your Focus is full.

lines.beginners-stance: Everyone starts here. Your first stance is waiting at the dojo!
lines.ready-stance: Steady and even. Good at everything.
lines.cat-stance: Quicker Counters and Dash, but softer blocks.
lines.front-stance: Hit harder, but move a little slower.
lines.fighting-stance: Strong blocks and fast Focus, but a shorter Dash.
lines.horse-stance: Stand still to hit harder, but move slower.
lines.shield-of-respect: A shield that soaks up hits for a while.
lines.second-wind: Brings back Health and some Focus.
lines.perfect-discipline: For a short time, every Counter is a Great Counter.

notYetLines.ready-stance: Not yet! Learn Open Leg Stance at the dojo, and your teacher will sign it off.

welcomeStance: Welcome! You start in Beginner's Stance, just like everyone. Learn stances at the dojo to grow stronger!
